## Vintage and revision

2020 to 2025, written by run `20261024T133318Z` (the write under the lock, offline), which read the zip saved at 2026-10-24T13:31:50Z (`retrieved_at`). `vintage` is the zip's last-modified time, 2026-10-19T12:30:44Z. Every run that is not `--offline` asks again and writes the table again (`write_snapshot`). No row carries StatCan's revision mark at this vintage.

## Shape and variables

Series, 3,024 rows, 41 entities (14 areas, three classes), 30 fuels.

- `entity`: `statcan_tf:<area>:<class>`.
  - area: `ca`, or a province's or territory's postal code in lower case;
  - class: `all` ("Total all classes of electricity"), `utilities` ("Electricity producers, electricity utilities [2211]") or `industries`.
- `variable`: `generation_<fuel>`. The fuels:
  - natural gas; coal by rank and origin (Canadian and imported bituminous and subbituminous, lignite);
  - heavy fuel oil by origin; light fuel oil, diesel, propane;
  - petroleum coke, coke oven gas, other gaseous, liquid and solid fuels;
  - wood, spent pulping liquor, biogas, steam from waste heat;
  - uranium.

  StatCan's totals are fuels of their own: `generation_total_generation`, `_total_coal`, `_total_gas`, `_total_liquids`, `_total_solids`, `_total_petroleum_products`, `_total_heavy_fuel_oil`, `_total_bituminous_coal` and `_total_subbituminous_coal`.
- `unit` MWh, as StatCan gives it. `ts_utc` the year's 1 January; `freq` P1Y; `geo` CA or CA-<province>.
- `node`: the area, class and line as StatCan names them; `x_class`, `x_fuel`; `x_vector`; `x_revised`.

189 values are 0; none is negative. `all` holds `utilities` and `industries`, and the totals hold their fuels: a sum takes one level.

| Canada, TWh | 2020 | 2025 |
|---|---|---|
| Natural gas | 69.9 | 118.3 |
| Canadian subbituminous coal | 22.4 | 0.0 |
| Uranium | 92.6 | 81.5 |

## Reading the source

- The run stops, asking nothing, while `statcan_thermal_fuel` or the host is paused.
- One request a run (timeout 180 seconds, 2 seconds' pause); `--offline` reads the saved zip.
- **Only the lines "<fuel>, electricity generated" are taken.** Not taken, and counted in the header:
  - "<fuel>, fuel consumed" (2,746 rows, in cubic metres, kilolitres, tonnes and kilograms, units the data standard does not hold);
  - "<fuel>, cost of fuel" (2,547 rows in Canadian dollars).
- A figure StatCan marks ".." or "x" has no row and is counted; none at this vintage.
- The run stops, and no file is written, for any of these:
  - a zip that does not hold 25100084.csv alone;
  - a generation line in a unit other than megawatt hours, or a scalar factor other than units;
  - an area, class or status not in the map;
  - a year that does not read;
  - a key given twice.

Nothing is filled.
